body:
PROBLEM (hit on PR #493, 2026-08-14): `assertBaseTicketContractsPreserved` (packages/rails-guard/lib/ci/rail-freeze.mjs) compares the ticket store at the BASE TIP against the store in the PR HEAD tree. A PR branched before any store change on the base therefore reads as 'altering' tickets it never touched: after PR #509 batch-marked 42 tickets `completed: true` on main, PR #493 — whose commits only ADD nine new shards — was denied with 'base ticket T-01KYJ3NMV8ZZDFD9DB31DJEGJF contract cannot change in a PR', because its stale tree still carried that shard WITHOUT the completed flag (a reverse-direction diff misread as a removal). The workaround was a rebase; every long-lived PR carrying a stale store copy will re-hit this after any store change on the base. This is the identical stale-base defect class fixed for trust-root tiering and the change-set identity in #506 (merge-base anchoring), one gate over.

BUILD

Compare what THIS PR changed: base for the add-vs-alter comparison (and the base-ticket-removal check) becomes the store at `git merge-base <trustedBase> HEAD`, not at the base tip. Everything else keeps its current basis deliberately:
- the RAILS UNION and the T36 `completed` trust anchor stay read from the BASE TIP store (reading completion from the tip is the documented forge-resistance design; reading rails from the tip can only widen the frozen set, the fail-safe direction);
- `isCompletionAnnotationOnly`'s bounded allowance is unchanged (it now evaluates against the merge-base version of the ticket);
- an unresolvable merge-base fails closed (operational error), mirroring #506's behavior.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA

- AC1: fixture — branch point, then the base completes a RAILLESS ticket (tip store differs from merge-base store); a PR from the stale branch that does NOT touch the store → rail-freeze passes (no phantom alteration). Verify: new test in packages/rails-guard/test/, named in the build. This is the #493/#509 regression pinned.
- AC2: a PR that genuinely alters a ticket present at the merge-base → still denied with the existing message. Verify: same test file.
- AC3: a PR that removes a merge-base ticket → still denied. Verify: same test file.
- AC4: completion-annotation-only of a railless merge-base ticket → still allowed. Verify: same test file.
- AC5: rails union + T36 lifting still read the BASE TIP: a ticket completed on the tip after the branch point has its rails expired for this PR's freeze check (assert via fixture). Verify: same test file.
- AC6: suite green: npm test.

NOTES FOR THE BUILDER

- Re-verify how trustedBase/baseSnapshot are resolved in the current code before building (#500 touched this area); the merge-base must come from the same pinned revision discipline the file already uses (see its TOCTOU comments).
- Enforcement-package change: tiers trust-root, needs a distinct-provider cross-model approve.
- No rails declared here (2026-08-14 lesson); freeze tests in-session during the build.
title: rails-guard-ci: anchor the ticket-store add-vs-alter comparison to the merge-base, not the base tip
